Bulk update objects in two ways:



**Filter + set:** Match objects with --filter and apply --set field values (same
kind).



**File:** Pass --file with a YAML array of per-object updates:

- id: BLI-001

updates:

title: "Updated Title"

status: validated



When using --file, the object kind is required as the first argument (e.g.

`zqk object bulk update backlog_item --file updates.yaml`).

--file is mutually exclusive with --filter and --set.



Optional --fields restricts each updated object in the success payload to those
top-level keys

(same hybrid projection as object get).

  Update by filter
  zqk.test object bulk update backlog_item --filter status=planned --set status=in_progress
  Per-object updates from file
  zqk.test object bulk update backlog_item --file updates.yaml
  Dry-run filter path
  zqk.test object bulk update backlog_item --filter status=planned --set status=in_progress --dry-run
  Dry-run file path
  zqk.test object bulk update backlog_item --file updates.yaml --dry-run

Usage:
  zqk.test object bulk update <kind> [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --dry-run                 Show what would be done without actually doing it
      --fields stringArray      Top-level keys per successful object in output (hybrid projection).
      --file string             YAML file: array of {id, updates: {field: value}}. Mutually exclusive with --filter/--set. Requires kind as first argument when set.
      --filter stringArray      Filter objects to update (e.g., --filter status=planned). Can be repeated.
      --force                   Force mode: skip 'not found' errors (treat missing objects as success)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
      --keep-file               Keep the source file after update (default: temp files like tmp-*.yaml are removed automatically)
      --kind string             Optional kind when not specified as the first argument or inferred from filter
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --relaxed                 Relax integrity constraints during bulk update (allow references to objects that will be created later in batch operations). Note: Auto-detected for bulk operations, this flag is optional.
  -s, --set stringArray         Set field values (e.g., --set status=in_progress). Can be repeated.
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
